newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Citicorp unit buys PLDT preferred shares.
newsitem.headline: Citicorp unit buys PLDT preferred shares.

text.p: Citicorp Capital Philippines Inc, a local investment banking arm of Citicorp International, had subscribed to the capital increase of Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co (PLDT), a statement from the Philippine Stock Exchange said on Monday. Citicorp Capital paid and subscribed to one billion pesos worth of preferred shares of PLDT, the exchange notice said.
A Citicorp Capital official said the investment is for the company's own account.
The Securities and Exchange Commission had recently approved the capital increase of PLDT to 8.5 billion from 4.5 billion pesos.
The new capital structure raised the number of preferred shares to 783 million from 383 million shares at the same par value of ten pesos each.
The number of common shares had remained at 134 million at the same par value of five pesos each.
